name: dbmcp
description: The privacy first MCP server for SQL databases.

interface.shortDescription: The privacy first MCP server for SQL databases
interface.longDescription: The privacy first MCP server for SQL databases. Sensitive data in query results is redacted before Codex sees it, per-column privacy rules rewrite ruled columns whole, and the server is read-only by default. Works with MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, and SQLite.
defaultPrompt: Set up dbmcp to connect to my database.
Explore the database schema and summarize the main tables.
Hide the email and phone columns from query results.
